gates.G4: nominal release date after the week-ending on every row
gates.G5: every series weekly without gaps over 2010-2023 (>= 700 weeks)

shape: TIDY -- one row per (series, week_ending); value in kbbl or bcf; release_date_nominal is w+5 (WPSR) / w+6 (WNGSR)
known_at_rule: the runner conditions on a week only when week_ending + 7 calendar days <= the month-end session (covers holiday shifts and the June 2022 outage)
vintage: current revised values; EIA revises weekly stocks; no vintage archive
